nfl.oneThing: Myles Garrett is making good progress from knee surgery, but the Rams are unlikely to open his practice window next week, so there is still no return timeline.

headlines.title: Myles Garrett making progress, but no return timeline yet
headlines.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay says Garrett is "making good progress" in his recovery from knee surgery. The team is unlikely to open his 21-day practice window next week.
headlines.whyItMatters: Los Angeles sit 2–2 and seventh in the NFC, so Garrett's timeline matters for a team still near the bottom of the playoff picture.

headlines.title: Patriots place Mack Hollins on injured reserve
headlines.summary: New England placed wide receiver Mack Hollins on injured reserve on Saturday with a calf injury. The Patriots host the Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.whyItMatters: New England are 2–2 and seventh in the AFC, and losing a receiver for Sunday's game adds pressure on the passing game.

headlines.title: Dolphins activate Kenneth Grant from injured reserve
headlines.summary: Defensive lineman Kenneth Grant is set to make his 2026 debut for Miami.
headlines.whyItMatters: Miami are 0–4 after four straight losses, so Grant's return adds depth to a defensive line in a team that needs wins.

headlines.title: Jack Campbell fined, faces suspension if it happens again
headlines.summary: Detroit linebacker Jack Campbell has been hit with a fine. A repeat offence three times could result in a suspension. The amount of the fine isn't in the data.
headlines.whyItMatters: Nothing changes on the field yet, but Campbell now has a warning on his record that carries a suspension risk.

headlines.title: Bears activate Noah Sewell from the PUP list
headlines.summary: Chicago have activated Noah Sewell from the physically unable to perform list.
headlines.whyItMatters: Chicago are 3–1 and fifth in the NFC, and getting Sewell back from the PUP list adds a player to their roster ahead of the season's next stage.

contextCard.title: How playoff tiebreakers work
contextCard.body: When teams finish with the same record, the NFL uses a set order of tiebreakers to decide seeding and playoff spots. The first step is usually head-to-head results, then division record and other measures. Early in the season the order rarely matters, but it becomes important as records bunch together.

playoffPicture.note: Seeds 1 to 4 are the division leaders. 5 to 7 are wild cards. Only the No. 1 seed gets a first-round bye.

nba.oneThing: The Warriors have signed Brandin Podziemski to a reported $110 million extension over five years, which keeps their cap flexibility largely intact.

headlines.title: Warriors sign Brandin Podziemski to a $110 million extension
headlines.summary: Golden State have signed Brandin Podziemski to a five-year extension worth a reported $110 million.
headlines.whyItMatters: The deal uses only $2 million of the cap space the Warriors created for next summer, which keeps them flexible for their push with Stephen Curry.

headlines.title: Grades for 2026 free agency signings and extensions
headlines.summary: The biggest offseason signings and extensions have been graded, including Jalen Duren's new five-year deal.
headlines.whyItMatters: These moves set up the rosters for the 2026-27 season, and the grades give a clear read on which teams spent their money well.

headlines.title: Suns host the Spurs in preseason home opener
headlines.summary: Phoenix host San Antonio in their first home game of the 2026-27 preseason.
headlines.whyItMatters: It's a preseason game, so the result carries no standings weight, but it's a chance to see how the Spurs are coming together.

headlines.title: Pistons beat the Suns in their first preseason win
headlines.summary: Detroit got their first preseason win over Phoenix and are now preparing to face the Wizards.
headlines.whyItMatters: Preseason results don't count in the standings, but the early win gives Detroit a bit of momentum.
